args.title: Correct the password reset email link to use the configured URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently generates a link using a hardcoded localhost URL. We need to change this to use the configured PUBLIC_URL instead, ensuring the link directs users to the correct site rather than localhost.
